name: drive_tiles
odbl: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database Licence (ODbL) 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
odbl_note: the corridor's proportions are derived from the OSM extracts in data/osm_cache/, so the derived map data this set belongs to carries the ODbL line verbatim; the game's own art and story do not
rule: NES: 1 shared backdrop $0F, 4 background palettes of 3 entries, a 16x16 area carries at most 3 colours besides the backdrop, at most 25 colours on screen; every pixel is a 2C02 output

scale.dash_note: 2 m mark and 6 m gap is one 8 m tile exactly; the motorway's own 2 m mark and 7 m gap is a 9 m cycle and would need a 3 tile repeat, which this sheet does not guarantee

sources.a33_lanes: A33 Town Quay way/8150576, highway=primary, lanes=3, surface=asphalt, lit=yes, oneway=yes, 30 mph (data/osm_cache/southampton_town_quay.json)
sources.a33_lanes4: A33 way/24594762, highway=primary, lanes=4, surface=asphalt, lit=yes (data/osm_cache/southampton_town_quay.json)
sources.width7: A3211 Victoria Embankment way/236139546, width=7, lane_markings=no, oneway=yes, lit=yes (data/osm_cache/westminster_big_ben.json)
sources.lit: lit=yes is tagged on 125 of the 237 highway ways in data/osm_cache/southampton_town_quay.json
sources.dest: Bridge Street way/406370787, destination:lanes:backward=A3211|A23: a sign that names the destination of the lanes under it (data/osm_cache/westminster_big_ben.json)
sources.shoulder_no: shoulder=no is tagged on 9 primary ways in data/osm_cache/westminster_big_ben.json (Parliament Square, Westminster Bridge, Broad Sanctuary), so a hard shoulder is not in the extract
sources.barrier_none: the extracts carry barrier= only 4 times (city_wall twice, wall twice) and no safety barrier, so the motorway barrier is not in the extract
sources.motorway_spec: SPEC: the M3 is a motorway, so the corridor has a hard shoulder and a safety barrier; the drive shot list puts a gantry over it (knowledge/DRIVE-SHOT-LIST.md sections 3 and 5)

asphalt.why: the tarmac, and the steel of the gantry in the dark

bright.why: lane paint, the sign border, the lit rail edge

dim.why: road grain, the shade under a line, the barrier face

gold.why: the sodium lamp head and the marker's reflector

green_deep.why: the verge floor and the mass of the hedge

green_lit.why: the gantry sign's face, as the drive's own sign uses it

green_mid.why: the grass blades and the kerb's grass above it

green_pale.why: the moonlit tips of the grass and the hedge's top edge

stone_mid.why: the kerb face, the marker post, the lamp column
